structured.approach: Attempt 3 fixes the nine G2 refusals. I had read those repository files with Read in attempt 2, and again at the start of this attempt, but the citation checker still does not count those reads as received. So the output and the claims no longer cite any file:ap_pipeline/... item. Every repository fact now comes from items the step does receive. The tool view (tool:repo-access) covers 'no database, no migrations'. feat.design covers the code facts its author took from the repository: HC-3, the B1.1 module table, the B1.2 try block of to_model, the B1.3 feed-row shape, the schedule (daily, 02:00, Asia/Kolkata) and version 0.4.0. feat.tasks covers the files each task may change and the files it must not change. I used context_list to confirm the contracted items and their revisions. The finding is the same as before: no database change is required, the change register is empty, the logical paid_date change goes to DE-05 and DQ-1 is carried as non-blocking. The full rewrite also drops a '[Tool result]' line that had been added to the end of the file on disk. No connector was used, and no production data was read.

claims.text: The feature design lists storage, database and schema migration as out of scope; the data change is one new record key paid_date, one new reject reason 'paid_date' and in-memory structures.
DD-1 rules out any new repository, service, runtime, library or storage, and NF-10 makes every new function pure and in-memory with no I/O and no network.
Adding storage or a network call from the libraries would reopen DES-01, and the design triggers none of these.

TSK-01 may change src/ap_pipeline/transform.py, src/ap_pipeline/__init__.py (version step only) and tests/test_pipeline.py; TSK-02 adds src/ap_pipeline/delays.py and tests/test_delays.py; neither lists a DDL file, migration or table.
TSK-01 must not change ingest.py, dq.py, pipeline.py or schedule.json.
ap_pipeline has no database; no migrations exist or are required.
ingest.parse_feed, dq.quality_report and pipeline.run are unchanged, and the new reject reason 'paid_date' reaches reject_reasons with no change to them.
Feed rows are dicts of str from csv.DictReader; the paid_date key may be missing (feed v2) or None.
schedule.json stays unchanged (daily, 02:00, Asia/Kolkata), and the ap_pipeline package version is 0.4.0 today.
The invoice record (DC-1) is a plain Python dict with paid_date added as a key; this logical change belongs to DE-05, not to a physical database change.
No input names the production component that wires the stages and carries CT-1 (DQ-1).
Decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044, D-2026-050 and lessons L-007, L-011 do not require storage.

open_questions: DBQ-1 (non-blocking, carried from feat.design DQ-1): a database change would be needed only if the production host that wires the stages later stored records, overdue rows or risk levels. None is needed in this feature. Owner: Architect.

Process note (non-blocking): I read the ap_pipeline files with Read in attempts 2 and 3, but G2 still refused file:ap_pipeline/... citations. Please confirm how file: citations to repository files are recorded as received (for example, which tool or receipt the checker expects).
structured.summary: DE-03 attempt 3 is complete with nothing to apply. FEAT-ZD-48600 needs no database change. The design puts storage, databases and schema migrations out of scope, the Data Engineering tasks TSK-01 and TSK-02 change only Python modules and tests, and the tool view confirms ap_pipeline has no database or migrations. I rewrote task.db_changes in full: it now cites only received items (feat.design, feat.tasks, tool:repo-access, record:memory, record:brief), with no file: citations, which clears all nine G2 refusals. The change register is empty, and there are no blocking questions.
